startup_guards: Retry busy GPU lock; recheck >=14500 MiB free under acquired lock; log waiting/errors; archive console.log and log.txt
version: V2 V0 Dinomaly + paired feature denoising; no AMCM
initialization: Fresh pretrained DINOv2 and V0 seed1 reconstruction; no trained checkpoint reuse
input: 512 full frame resized to 392; no spatial crop

validation.checkpoint_selection: maximum image AUROC; tie pixel AP
validation.threshold_selection: maximum validation image F1 per corresponding checkpoint

test.usage: after complete training, best validation checkpoint and reference final

evaluation: Unchanged V0/V1 historical 256 evaluator; no scoring or threshold change
independent_checks: Static AST/source review only; no smoke, subset, short-run training or model forward checks.
gpu_policy: After completed Bridge, wait for GPU0 free >=14500 MiB; never stop another job
publication_gate: Dedicated plan/code commit pushed and remote ref verified before launch; clean immutable server checkout records actual commit. Bridge completes before independently initialized DACL. No smoke or tuning.

paired_training.foreground: full image; no industrial foreground rules or defect masks
paired_training.target: stopgrad encoder-only grouped features of paired clean image; clean batches reuse forward targets
